metadata.description: Agent skills for Aries Tools TypeScript development: shared conventions, the @ariestools/toolchain xy CLI, ESLint and TypeScript configs, Vitest presets, dependency policy, the @ariestools/sdk utility libraries, the @ariestools/sdk-react React UI libraries, actor-kit actors and providers with their cli-kit and browser-kit hosts, repository documentation conventions for agents (AGENTS.md, docs/papers lifecycle, xy agent lint), product planning from idea to MVP (papers, roadmap, per-version PRDs), and distributed architecture with autonomous replaceable workers, protocol-defined authority, reconciliation, safe concurrency and justified coordination.
